title: Claim Activity Funds
how: Builds up for 48 hours, so claim at least every other day. Activate Bonus adds 30% Gold and EXP.

title: Gates: use your Dungeon Entry Keys
how: Best daily EXP. Pick the reward you need, and claim Gate missions before you level up.

title: Dispatch mining teams
how: Use Dispatch All on cleared gates; they leave the list after 168 hours.

title: Unstable Dungeon
how: Free keys on the artifact you set in Reward Settings.

title: Battlefield of Chaos
how: Gems. Sweep tiers whose Battle Missions are done.

title: Mind Rift
how: Cores and core growth material.

title: Workshop of Brilliant Light
how: 2 free invitations come back each day; do not sit at the cap.

title: Shadow Enforcer missions
how: Send Shadows out before you log off.

title: Daily Missions
how: Claim every point reward.

title: Hunter Pass missions
how: Pass EXP for its tier rewards.

title: Push one more Story or Hard stage
how: First clears give Essence Stones and Custom Draw Tickets.

title: Weekly Missions to the maximum
how: If you do not reach the maximum, the points carry over instead of resetting.

title: Hunters Association Missions
how: Changes every weekly reset.

title: Unstable Dungeon Conquest Missions
how: Artifact materials by number of clears.

title: Battlefield of Chaos clear-count rewards
how: The clear count resets every week.

title: Power of Calamity, and last week's rank reward
how: Rank rewards can only be claimed during the following week.

title: Simulation Gate: use every Entry Code
how: Codes reset to the maximum each week, so unused codes are wasted.

title: Edge of Illusion and Dreams: 5 tickets
how: In season only.

title: Deep Containment Zone keys
how: Keys refill weekly.

title: Guild Boss with both teams
how: Your two best scores add up.

title: Try new Battlefield of Trials floors
how: Rate Up Draw Tickets on the way up.

title: Battlefield of Time: each boss under 1:30
how: All top Achievement Rewards. Figures and guild buffs do not apply here.

title: The Architect's Test
how: Essence Stones; rewards reset each season.

title: The Overseer's Forbidden Library
how: Stage rewards once per season.

title: Hall of the Monarchs
how: No entry cost, unlimited retries.

title: Seasonal Cards
how: Cards and Card Points reset when the season ends; spend the points first.

title: Special Summons (subscribers)
how: Confirm your pick before the period ends.
